title: Pearmut: Human Evaluation of Translation Made Trivial
abstract: arXiv:2601.02933v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Human evaluation is the gold standard for multilingual NLP, but is often skipped in practice and substituted with automatic metrics because it is notoriously complex and slow to set up with existing tools with substantial engineering and operational overhead. We introduce Pearmut, a lightweight yet feature-rich platform that makes end-to-end human evaluation as easy to run as automatic evaluation. Pearmut removes common entry barriers and provides support for evaluating multilingual tasks, with a particular focus on machine translation. The platform implements standard evaluation protocols, including DA, ESA, and MQM, and is extensible to support new protocols. It features document-level context, absolute and contrastive evaluation, attention checks, ESAAI pre-annotations and both static and dynamic assignment strategies. translated_title: Pearmut：让人工翻译评估变得轻而易举
translated_abstract: 人工评估是多语言NLP的黄金标准，但在实践中常被跳过并用自动指标替代，因为使用现有工具搭建人工评估流程非常复杂且耗时，需要大量的工程和运营开销。我们提出了Pearmut，一个轻量级但功能丰富的平台，使端到端的人工评估像自动评估一样易于运行。Pearmut消除了常见的入门障碍，并支持多语言任务的评估，尤其侧重于机器翻译。该平台实现了标准评估协议，包括DA、ESA和MQM，并且可扩展以支持新的协议。它具备文档级上下文、绝对评估与对比评估、注意力检查、ESAAI预标注以及静态和动态任务分配策略等功能。Pearmut使可靠的人工评估成为模型开发和诊断中实用且常规的组成部分。
tldr: Pearmut是一个轻量级且功能丰富的平台，让端到端的人工翻译评估变得像自动评估一样简单易行，支持DA、ESA、MQM等标准评估协议，使人工评估成为模型开发中的常规环节。
